_comment: EGM Downloader Linux — informational, no auto-update. Upload to egerena.com/apps/egmlinux-update.json
_version_notes: Security: outbound HTTP requests now restricted to a whitelist of trusted hosts (GitHub, PyPI, ffmpeg sources, egerena.com) — prevents any future code path from accidentally reaching unintended destinations
Security: redirect targets verified against the same whitelist — blocks redirects that lead off-list, even from legitimate hosts
Security: archive extractions (ffmpeg, Deno, app installer) now explicitly guard against path traversal — defense in depth alongside Python's existing zipfile sanitization
Security: job queue bounded to prevent unbounded memory growth in long sessions — returns 429 if a session ever accumulates 1000+ jobs
Polish: HTTP timeouts centralized into two named constants (15s for metadata, 120s for downloads) — consistent behavior across every outbound request

Theme files synchronized with canonical definitions — corrects rendering of Ghost of Sparta (Cyrillic character typo) and Neo Geo (malformed color value), aligns naming with current branding (Evergreen, Meadow, Aurora Deep), brings Linux theme picker in line with Windows/Mac

notes: Security: outbound HTTP requests now restricted to a whitelist of trusted hosts (GitHub, PyPI, ffmpeg sources, egerena.com) — prevents any future code path from accidentally reaching unintended destinations
Security: redirect targets verified against the same whitelist — blocks redirects that lead off-list, even from legitimate hosts
Security: archive extractions (ffmpeg, Deno, app installer) now explicitly guard against path traversal — defense in depth alongside Python's existing zipfile sanitization
Security: job queue bounded to prevent unbounded memory growth in long sessions — returns 429 if a session ever accumulates 1000+ jobs
Polish: HTTP timeouts centralized into two named constants (15s for metadata, 120s for downloads) — consistent behavior across every outbound request

Theme files synchronized with canonical definitions — corrects rendering of Ghost of Sparta (Cyrillic character typo) and Neo Geo (malformed color value), aligns naming with current branding (Evergreen, Meadow, Aurora Deep), brings Linux theme picker in line with Windows/Mac
Security: API token comparison hardened to constant-time (hmac.compare_digest) — closes theoretical timing-attack vector on the per-session token check
Security: audio bitrate values validated before use in yt-dlp postprocessor args — invalid values now rejected cleanly (was: unvalidated interpolation)
Security: format_id values validated against allowed character set before use in yt-dlp format selector — prevents unexpected selector injection
Electron runtime upgraded from v29 to v41 — brings 12 major versions of Chromium security fixes and performance improvements

Security: renderer process sandbox hardened where supported — AppImage runs without OS-level sandbox (AppImage SUID limitation); all other security layers active (CSP, token auth, navigation handlers, checksum verification)
Security: external links always open in your default browser; in-window navigation locked to the local app origin
Security: Content-Security-Policy enforced on all app pages — blocks external scripts, iframes, and plugins
Security: HTML escape helper strengthened with single-quote handling (defensive — no current vulnerability, eliminates future foot-gun)
Security: dependency download integrity now strictly enforced — ffmpeg and Deno installs require valid upstream checksums to proceed (previously fell back silently on verification errors)
Security: release notes from update feed now rendered as text only — eliminates potential script injection from compromised feeds
Security: open download folder now validates path is an existing directory — prevents the IPC handler from being used to launch arbitrary files
ffmpeg and Deno downloads now verified against upstream SHA256 checksums — protects against tampered or corrupted dependency binaries
ffmpeg checksum verification uses BtbN's published checksums.sha256
Auto-update dialog now correctly passes feed checksum to download verification — fixes "Checksum required" error blocking app updates
Subtitle temp file cleanup safety net — leftover .vtt/.srt files now reliably removed after embedded subtitle downloads
